 Sony’s Bend Studio Reportedly Plans a 2027 Reveal and Possible Release for Its Third-Person Co-Op Game, Despite Starting the Project Only in Mid-2025
 Alessio Palumbo • 
 Nov 1, 2026 at 12:30pm EST 
 Comments 
 Add to Preferred Sources
 According to a fresh rumor, the next game by Sony's Bend Studio is a third-person co-op game due to be revealed and possibly released in 2027.

 Timeline 4/5 
 According to a fresh rumor posted by MP1st , Sony -owned developer Bend Studio will announce and possibly even release its next project in 2027 , since it's much further along in development than anyone had thought up to this point.
 This is truly a major surprise because previous reports mentioned that Bend Studio had only begun the project in June 2025, following the cancellation of its unannounced open world live-service game earlier in 2025 . At that time, the Oregon-based developer also shed 30% of its workforce , making its progress even more challenging.
 Related Story Ghost of Yōtei Sold 3.3 Million Copies in Its First Month, Yet Sony’s Sucker Punch Still Cut 26 Jobs 
 To launch a (presumably) triple-A game in less than three years would be unthinkable nowadays, at least from scratch. The obvious conclusion is that they must have been able to reuse a lot of the code and assets they had produced for the canceled game . MP1st doesn't provide much information about the new title, other than that it won't be a live-service game . However, it will be a third-person co-op game. 
 It won't be a Days Gone sequel, that's for sure. Sony notoriously rejected that pitch several years ago , despite the 2019 game's decent profitability . I personally maintain that it's massively underrated and absolutely deserved a follow-up game .
 Weirdly enough, Sony did release Days Gone Remastered and the Broken Road DLC in April 2025, adding new content such as Horde Assault (a Survival Arcade mode), a Permadeath mode, and a Speedrun mode, suggesting they believed at least a little in the IP. The franchise was also going to be adapted to the big screen , but that project appears to be dead, given there have been no updates for over four years.
 Hopefully, Bend Studio can catch a break with this upcoming project. Since it's a co-op game, it will likely launch on PC alongside PlayStation 5 , just like Helldivers.
